newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - FOB values mostly unchanged.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - FOB values mostly unchanged.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean offers were mostly unchanged Thursday in quiet dealings, exporters said.
U.S. export markets were quiet, and weather in the U.S. Midwest continued to hold the attention of traders, they said.
Arctic air ushered in subzero temperatures to much of U.S. on Thursday, so ice in parts of the Illinois and Mississippi Rivers slowed barge transportation..
In export news, Morocco bought 40,000 tonnes French wheat, and Algeria bought 125,000 soft wheat from France as well as 25,000 tonnes of optional origin, traders said.
Japan also bought 120,000 tonnes of wheat, consisting of 20,000 Canadian, 40,000 tonnes of Australian and 60,000 tonnes of U.S.
